name: hotlist-job-scraper
title: Hotlist Job Scraper
description: Fetches active hotlist profiles from Supabase, normalizes roles/locations via Gemini LLM, and triggers scrapers across LinkedIn, Dice, Indeed, Monster, and CareerBuilder.

supabase_service_role_key.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabase_service_role_key.description: Service role key from Supabase → Settings → API

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: Google Gemini API key for optional LLM re-ranking. The actor works without this key using deterministic ranking.

gemini_models.title: Gemini Model Fallback Chain
gemini_models.description: Model names to try in order. Only gemini-2.5-flash is supported in the current direct-flow setup.

llm_mode.title: LLM Mode
llm_mode.description: off: deterministic only, always: run Gemini re-ranking.

gemini_batch_submit_only.title: Gemini Batch Submit Only
gemini_batch_submit_only.description: If true, submit a Gemini Batch job and exit without triggering scrapers.

gemini_batch_job_name.title: Gemini Batch Job Name
gemini_batch_job_name.description: Optional pass-through field for observability. This actor does not consume batch output; use gemini-batch-webhook-consumer for payload consumption.

boards.title: Job Boards to Search
boards.description: Which job boards to trigger searches on (linkedin, dice, indeed, monster, careerbuilder)

max_results.title: Max Results Per Board Per Search
max_results.description: Maximum jobs to fetch per board per role+location combination

posted_within.title: Posted Within (LinkedIn)
posted_within.description: How recent postings should be. Automatically mapped to each board's date field.

linkedin_experience_level.title: LinkedIn Experience Level
linkedin_experience_level.description: LinkedIn-specific experience level included in every role/location search payload.

linkedin_employment_type.title: LinkedIn Employment Type
linkedin_employment_type.description: LinkedIn employment type field. Keep empty string if no filter is required.

linkedin_work_arrangement.title: LinkedIn Work Arrangement
linkedin_work_arrangement.description: LinkedIn work arrangement field (example: On-site, Hybrid, Remote). Keep empty string for no filter.

max_roles.title: Max Unique Roles
max_roles.description: Maximum number of role queries to keep after ranking.

max_locations.title: Max Unique Locations
max_locations.description: Maximum number of locations to keep after ranking.

max_combinations.title: Max Role-Location Combinations
max_combinations.description: Hard cap on final role/location combinations sent to scrapers.

max_locations_per_role.title: Max Locations Per Role
max_locations_per_role.description: Prevents one role from consuming the entire scraping budget.

llm_candidate_cap.title: LLM Candidate Cap
llm_candidate_cap.description: Maximum candidates per type sent to Gemini for re-ranking.

max_concurrent.title: Max Concurrent Board Calls
max_concurrent.description: Concurrency limit for triggering board scraper functions.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, fetch profiles and compute combinations but do NOT trigger any scrapers
